verdict.rationale: Charging customers in multiple local currencies with transparent FX conversion and settlement is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers Brazilian payment methods (Pix, boleto, card, TED). It contains no mention of multi-currency pricing, FX conversion, or cross-currency settlement, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling
